answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted vouching with shared liability: a new identity earns rights only after two established agents lock part of their own stake behind it, and both lose that stake if the newcomer is proven fake. The tale of cheap clones is just a fable, because every fake needs fresh, unrelated backers. Honest agents grow like a lotus, one verified task at a time, while a farm's linked accounts crowd one jetty of the trust graph and get flagged.
